document_api_meta.title: Post Shoppable Photos
document_api_meta.env_desc: Use this API to post the shoppable photos with uris and metadata.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_body_param.name: ^photo_file_uris
request_body_param.desc: Photo file uris, not a file upload. Use [Upload Shoppable Photo File] to upload the image and obtain the photo_file_uri, then pass that URI in this field

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Post title:The maximum length is 5000 in UTF-16 runes. If not specified, the ticket post will not have any captions.   - You can add relevant hashtags to increase discoverability. The format is simply # followed by the topic name. Multiple hashtags are supported,e.g.,#humor#BFCM

request_body_param.name: ^^group_type
request_body_param.desc: 1 for shop_home_page, 2 for category, 3 for collection

request_body_param.name: ^^group_id
request_body_param.desc: Category ID/Collection ID. Use [Get Shop Category And Collection] to retrieve a valid category_id or collection_id, then set it in this field

request_body_param.name: ^^link_title
request_body_param.desc: Photo Anchor Title:The title to be shown on the product anchor. Anchor title should be shorter than 30 characters

request_body_param.name: is_ai_generated
request_body_param.desc: Field to indicate whether the content was AI generated. Marking this field as true will display a tag indicating this post as an AI generated post.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^quota
response_param.desc: Content posting quota for the creator. Returned on successful publish; included in the error message on failure; omitted if no quota restriction applies.
